subject: Syntax for Indirect and total effects in BSEM including multiple predictors and outcomes

messages.author: f767f57fb3113a98
messages.subject: Syntax for Indirect and total effects in BSEM including multiple predictors and outcomes
parts:
Dear List members,

I wonder what would be the most practical way of computing indirect and total effects of the following model  including multiple predictors, outcomes and a latent variable as mediator (see also graphics in the attachmenets):

Many thanks in advance for your comments:

 # LV Measurement Model
 # Mediator LV definitions
 M =~ 1*m1 + b2*m2 + b3*m3 + b4*m4

 # Mediator LV variances and covariances
 M ~~ M
 
 # Mediator MV residuals
 m1 ~~ e1.a*m1
 m2 ~~ e2.a*m2
 m3 ~~ e3.a*m3
 m4 ~~ e4.a*m4

 # Mediator MV means
 m1 ~ m1.a*1
 m2 ~ m2.a*1
 m3 ~ m3.a*1
 m4 ~ m4.a*1

 # BMeans and Covariances
 # MV residuals
 x1 ~~ e1.r.a*x1
 x2 ~~ e2.r.a*x2
 y1 ~~ e1.t.a*y1
 y2 ~~ e2.t.a*y2

  # MV means
 x1 ~ m1.r.a*1
 x2 ~ m2.r.a*1
 y1 ~ m1.t.a*1
 y2 ~ m2.t.a*1
 
  # Direct effects
M ~ x1 + x2
y1 ~ x1 + x2 + M
y2 ~ x1 + x2 + M
"

parts:
Thanks Ed, 

Something like this? (error message at the end)

> Model <- "

# LV Measurement Model
  # Mediator LV definitions
  M =~ 1*m1 + b2*m2 + b3*m3 + b4*m4

  # Mediator LV variances and covariances
  M ~~ M
   
  # Mediator MV residuals
  m1 ~~ e1.a*m1
  m2 ~~ e2.a*m2
  m3 ~~ e3.a*m3
  m4 ~~ e4.a*m4

  # Mediator MV means
  m1 ~ m1.a*1
  m2 ~ m2.a*1

m3 ~ m3.a*1
  m4 ~ m4.a*1

  # BMeans and Covariances
  # MV residuals
  x1 ~~ e1.r.a*x1
  x2 ~~ e2.r.a*x2
  y1 ~~ e1.t.a*y1
  y2 ~~ e2.t.a*y2

   # MV means
  x1 ~ m1.r.a*1
  x2 ~ m2.r.a*1
  y1 ~ m1.t.a*1
  y2 ~ m2.t.a*1

# Structural Model
#M ~ x1 + x2
#y1 ~ x1 + x2 + M
#y2 ~ x1 + x2 + M
   
  # Direct effects
  M ~ a1* x1 + a2*x2
 y1 ~ b1 * M + c1 * x1 + c2 * x2
 y2 ~ b2 * M + c3 * x1 + c4 * x2
            
 # Indirect Effect
 indirect1 := a1 * b1
 indirect2 := a2 * b1
 indirect3 := a1 * b2
 indirect4 := a2 * b2
 "
> fitModel <- blavaan(Model, data=toy, n.chains=1, burnin=1000, sample=1000, bcontrol=list(cores=4))
